# TRX Training

> > TRX Training offers suspension training equipment, professional fitness certification courses, and digital workout programs founded by Navy SEAL Randy Hetrick.

TRX specializes in suspension training systems including the Pro4 System, Home2 System, and accessories like YBell, Bandit, and RIP Trainer. The company provides both consumer products and commercial B2B solutions, alongside comprehensive professional education and certification programs for fitness professionals.
